card.name: Drug lists in interaction passages
card.fires_on: Marks a spot in interaction text just before the next item in a list of drugs: the 'c' starting cobicistat, the comma after carbamazepine, or 'class' before I or III antiarrhythmics.

modes.label: Start of cobicistat
modes.description: The letter c that begins cobicistat in arrows tables of antiretroviral interactions.
modes.example: ↓ atazanavir ↔ etravirine ↓ atazanavir ↓ cobicistat ↓ etravirine ↓<< c>>obicistat darunavir:

modes.label: Comma after carbamazepine
modes.description: The comma after carbamazepine, just before phenytoin and phenobarbital in enzyme-inducer lists.
modes.example: In women not taking carbamazepine<<,>> phenytoin, phenobarb

modes.label: Class before antiarrhythmic numerals
modes.description: The word class before I, IA or III in lists of QT-prolonging antiarrhythmics.
modes.example: Possible pharmacodynamic interactions can occur between droperidol and potentially arrhythmogenic agents such as<< class>> I or III antiarrhythmics,

card.plain: It fires in drug-interaction lists right before the next named drug or drug class is listed.
